definitions.gloss: change of address notification, moving notice
definitions.explanation: An official form submitted to the local municipal office when moving to a new address. Required by law when changing residence in Japan.

examples.japanese: {転居届|てんきょとどけ}を{出|だ}す。
examples.english: To submit a change of address notification.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}したら{転居届|てんきょとどけ}を{忘|わす}れずに。
examples.english: Don't forget to submit a change of address notification after moving.

examples.japanese: {転居届|てんきょとどけ}は{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}しの{前後|ぜんご}{十四日|じゅうよっか}{以内|いない}に{市区町村|しくちょうそん}{役場|やくば}に{提出|ていしゅつ}する。
examples.english: The change of address notification must be submitted to the municipal office within fourteen days before or after moving.

notes:
COMPONENTS: {転居|てんきょ} (change of residence) + {届|とどけ} (notification/report).

When moving within the same municipality, you submit a {転居届|てんきょとどけ}. When moving to a different municipality, the process involves a {転出届|てんしゅつとどけ} (moving-out notice) at the old address and a {転入届|てんにゅうとどけ} (moving-in notice) at the new address.

RELATED TERMS:
- {転出届|てんしゅつとどけ} — moving-out notification
- {転入届|てんにゅうとどけ} — moving-in notification
- {住民票|じゅうみんひょう} — resident certificate
- {市区町村|しくちょうそん}{役場|やくば} — municipal office
